name: bim_sync_clash_tests
author: hprebar
title: Sync the HP clash tests for a LOD
description: One Hard clash test per rule of the HP clash matrix (184 pairs, priority P1/P2/P3) eligible in ONE design phase: 200 basic design = 27 tests @ 50 mm, 300 technical design = 154 @ 30 mm, 350-400 construction drawings = 184 @ 10 mm (the sheet's column G covers both). Name HP|LOD<phase>|P<n>|<ARC-STR>|<A5 Doors>-<S2 Structural Walls> (sort Clash Detective by name; the API cannot create test folders); tests named the earlier ways (no group names, LOD350/LOD400) are renamed with their results kept. Selections = the two base search sets, except M4 pipes which select M4.9 (pipes D >= 32 mm, methodology note 3; run bim_sync_search_sets with apply=true first, it writes M4.9 too). Rules tab: ignore items in same group/block/cell always, coincident snap points only inside one discipline, never same layer or same file; Composite Object Clashing on. apply=false (default) previews create/update/unchanged/skip per rule and lists the HP tests of other phases and duplicates; apply=true writes, upserting by name, and reads every written test back. removeOtherPhases=true (approval needed, whole model only) also deletes those other-phase/duplicate HP tests — their results are lost; tests not named HP|… are never touched. A rule whose set is missing or empty is skipped, never widened. Does not run tests. One Undo entry; dryRun undoes it.

lod.description: Design phase: 200 = basic design (thiết kế cơ sở), 300 = technical design (thiết kế kỹ thuật), 350-400 = construction drawings (bản vẽ thi công); "350" and "400" are read as 350-400

apply.description: false = preview only; true = write the tests

priorities.description: Only these priorities (1 = HIGH, 2 = MEDIUM, 3 = LOW); empty = all

ruleIds.description: Only these rules, e.g. ["HP_A8_S2"]; empty = all eligible

listUnchanged.description: Also list the rules whose test is already up to date

removeOtherPhases.description: Delete the HP tests of the other design phases and duplicates (approval required; results are lost)

notes: Calls HPNavis.BIMCoordinator.CoordinatorTools.SyncClashTests with units.ToMm(1) so tolerances convert from mm to the document units (read back within 0.01 mm). Writes via DocumentClashTests.TestsAddCopy / TestsEditTestFromCopy; selections are SelectionSources of the saved search sets.
